title: Bad nights and Basie's calm
summary: Greene says he used to be upset when the rhythm was off but now takes it in stride; Basie stays calm.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: But, I think possibly you know from when -- Basie -- you know from when we were talking about the beginning -- when Basie really didn't -- he hadn't had to handle much of a business end of things,
had he? In those days there wasn't that much to worry about or think about.
No.
And, and he just sort of has taken it all in stride. Hasn't he? And, he's got to where he -- where it's like a defensive thing that he can do.

Well, I mean, he wouldn't want to point at anything. I mean, obviously different stages have been fairly happy for happier rhythm section than with the exception of others. What effect does that have on you though when you know an exception isn't exactly right? How does that affect you night after night. I mean, does it get on your nerves, or have you just sort of gotten so that you take it in stride?
Well, naturally if it's not right -- you know -- naturally -- I feel it, more or less while playing. But, I used to get upset, but I don't anymore.
You used to?
Yeah. But, I take it now in stride, more or less. Some nights it's good, and some nights it's not good. But, as I say, I usually take it in stride.
Well, when you went back farther to maybe, you know, maybe you were more hopeful -- you know -- it's alot of years isn't it?
That's right.
And, maybe when there had to be some changes in the rhythm section..
Mm hmm.
-- you were probably all very serious about getting it to what you wanted it to be.
Right.
But, then since you weren't always able to maintain it that way, and what-not I guess that you have to learn to live with it a little bit.
You have to.
And, Basie, I guess, does the same, huh?
I think so. I think he does.
Because you -- you're only human. And, you've only got one constitution.
Right. That's right. (laugh)
Well, Duke used to get mad with his rhythm section
Yeah.
Duke, really, I mean, that was one thing he used to lose his temper about.
Yeah?
He used to get mad. Bang on that piano, and, you know, he wouldn't speak much about musicians, but he'd speak about his bass and drums.
Mm hmm. Mm hmm.
And, I'm sure Basie must get pretty mad, at times, too.
He probably does, but he --
You can't upset him, can you?
I don't know whether he conditioned himself, or what-- to really not -- you know -- get upset, or what.
Yeah.
But, he doesn't get upset, you know --
He just doesn't let it
-- just doesn't let it -- you know.
